messages:
Riley (Finance): Team— odd spike on Feb invoice: hosted-models GPU line $47,850 tagged customer=unassigned team=null. Need owner mapping for month-end.

billing-bot: Alert: gpu_monthly_anomaly project=hosted-models spike detected 2026-02-16. /alerts/179500 :rotating_light:

Zoe (Infra): Can you paste the raw cost row or run cost-lookup? Untagged jobs land in shared bucket.

Riley (Finance): From cost export:
`2026-02-16 hosted-models gpu A100 $47,850 tags: customer=null,team=null,job=large-hyperparam-sweep-7`

Arjun (ML): That job name is ours. We ran a large hyperparam sweep for a customer POC 02/14-02/17. One batch accidentally used `reserved-highmem` template.

Zoe (Infra): Quick command to confirm templates:
```
cost-lookup --project hosted-models --filter "job==large-hyperparam-sweep-7" --group-by template,instance_type
```
It will show reserved vs preemptible split. I can also map job -> repo -> CODEOWNERS for owner attribution.

Natalie (Sales): If this is customer-facing POC, Sales may have an approved POC credit. I'll check contract notes for any GPU credit or PO line.

Riley (Finance): For provisional chargeback, we need a best-effort split now. If ML covers >$20k need director approval. Zoe, can infra send CSV mapping job->owner->cost?

Zoe (Infra): Sending CSV now. Provisional mapping suggests ML (Arjun) $34,000, POC credit potential $10,000, Platform overhead $3,850.

Riley (Finance): Filing FIN-9120 "POC GPU allocation request" with provisional invoice. I'll auto-approve up to $10k credit application; anything above requires director signoff. Link will be posted.

billing-bot: Ticket FIN-9120 created by Riley (Finance)  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-9120

Arjun (ML): Confirmed error on template selection. We'll absorb up to $12k and request credit/transfer for remainder. Will add a pre-submit check to our sweep script.

Natalie (Sales): Found contract note: "POC_CREDIT_GPU_5k" — will escalate to finance/legal for approval to apply $5k. Will update FIN-9120.

Zoe (Infra): Short-term mitigation applied: enforce required `--team` tag on submit, warn on `reserved` templates, and added daily alert for any single job > $4k.

Riley (Finance): Thanks all  closing provisional allocation; update FIN-9120 with approvals and we'll finalize month-end entries. :white_check_mark:
